items.title: 1.2 Jadeed periodic table: khusoosiyat aur ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.2, printed page 3.

blocks.text: Modern (jadeed) periodic table mein elements ki classification (groups mein baantna) un ki properties ko samajhna asaan banati hai. Modern periodic table ki chand bari khasoosiyaat (features) yeh hain:

items: Is waqt 118 elements table mein apne atomic numbers ki barhti tarteeb (ascending order) mein rakhe gaye hain.

Table mein saat horizontal (leti hui) rows hain jinhein periods kehte hain, aur athara vertical (khare) columns hain jinhein groups kehte hain. (Purane tables mein 8 vertical groups the jo do qism ke the: aath A-groups aur das B-groups.)

Ek hi group ke elements ki chemical properties milti-julti hoti hain kyun ke un ke valence electrons (bahar wale shell ke electrons) ki tadaad barabar hoti hai. Lekin group mein oopar se neeche jate hue un ki physical properties aahista aahista badalti hain.
Ek period mein baen (left) se daen (right) jate hue elements ki properties aahista aahista badalti hain.

blocks.text: Groups aur periods ke ilawa, samajh behtar karne ke liye elements ko blocks, families aur categories mein bhi baanta jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Chlorine aur bromine ek hi group mein hain; chlorine aur argon ek hi period mein hain. Kis jore ki chemical properties milti-julti hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Chlorine aur bromine ki. Ek group ke elements ke valence electrons barabar hote hain, aur chemical rawaiya (behaviour) inhi se tay hota hai; group mein neeche sirf physical properties aahista badalti hain. Chlorine aur argon ek period mein hain, jahan properties baen se daen qadam ba qadam badalti hain, is liye yeh dono kaafi mukhtalif hain.

items: 118 elements atomic number ki tarteeb mein; 7 periods aur 18 groups (purane tables: A aur B groups).
Ek group: barabar valence electrons, milti-julti chemistry. Ek period: baen se daen properties aahista badalti hain. Blocks, families aur categories mazeed grouping hain.
